findings.message: Tiered hinting scaffold levels (1-3) are preserved and bounded. Level clamping ensures hints stay within 1-3 range at all times.

Full-solution guardrail is implemented via _looks_like_full_solution() which detects and blocks hints that reveal complete answers. Fallback hint substitution and HINT_SCAFFOLD_GUARD safety event provide appropriate handling.

Adaptive difficulty system computes gentle adjustments using session context including recent_failures, recent_successes, stuck_seconds, and age band. Produces deterministic difficulty_adjustment payload with difficulty_scalar, spawn_rate_scale, reward_scale, and objective_steps.
Quest suggestion system via _build_adaptive_quest() generates contextual quest guidance. recommended_hint_level can nudge up/down gently and is clamped to 1..3 to prevent abrupt changes.
Companion metadata is now included in execute output: difficulty_adjustment, quest_suggestion, and reveals_full_solution (always false for default path).
Failsafe/model-unavailable behavior is preserved. Rules-based fallback is used when model is unavailable or failsafe is active. Adaptive metadata is still returned in these modes.

Test coverage added via run_task_027_tests.gd. All tests pass: Tests: 1  Checks: 12  Failed tests: 0. Additional regression validation confirms run_task_032_tests.gd also passes: Tests: 4  Checks: 51  Failed tests: 0.
